html: The text component is a simple component that can be used to style the text color of any element. The ion-text element should wrap the element in order to change the text color of that element.

html: The text component can be customized by changing any of the default colors Ionic provides.

DescriptionThe color to use from your application's color palette. Default options are: "primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "success", "warning", "danger", "light", "medium", and "dark". For more information on colors, see theming.
